description: Provides an interface to interact with both incoming and outgoing app links, including deep links, universal links, and custom URL schemes.

addEventListener.description: Adds a handler to Linking changes by listening to the 'url' event.

handler.description: Function called when the 'url' event is fired. Receives an object with a 'url' string.

addEventListener.returns: EmitterSubscription object, which has a remove() method to unsubscribe.

canOpenURL.description: Determines whether an installed app can handle a given URL.

url.description: The URL to check. For web URLs, include protocol (http:// or https://).

canOpenURL.returns: Promise<boolean> resolved to true if the URL can be handled, false otherwise.

getInitialURL.description: Returns the URL that triggered the app launch, or null if none.

openSettings.description: Opens the app's custom settings page in the system settings.

openURL.description: Opens the given URL with an installed app if possible.

url.description: The URL to open. Can be http(s), tel, mailto, geo, or custom URL schemes.

openURL.returns: Promise resolved if the URL opens successfully, rejected if it cannot be handled.

sendIntent.description: Android-only. Launches an Android intent with optional extras.
sendIntent.signature: sendIntent(action: string, extras?: Array<{key: string, value: string | number | boolean}>) => Promise<void>

action.description: The Android intent action to trigger.

extras.description: Optional array of key-value pairs to pass as extras in the intent.

notes: Supports deep links, universal links, and custom URL schemes.
Check canOpenURL() before opening non-http(s) URLs to prevent errors.
getInitialURL may return null during Remote JS Debugging on iOS.
sendIntent is Android-only and allows launching intents with optional data.
